newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM sees difficult year ahead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM sees difficult year ahead.

text.p: Base metals miner MIM Ltd said on Friday that it expected a difficult year in 1996/97 to June 30, mainly due to weaker copper prices.
"Taking into account economic and market conditions and the volatility of price and exchange rates, it is very difficult to forecast the financial result for 1996/97," the company said.
"However, given the present level of copper prices in particular, a difficult year is in prospect."

MIM said it was undertaking considerable investment leading to the commissioning of Alumbrera copper/gold project in Argentina and the Ernest Henry copper/gold project in northeast Queensland. "These developments span a two-year period and this period coincides with the progressive three-year investment plan for Mount Isa," chief executive Nick Stump said in a statement.
"Bearing this in mind it has been prudently decided to reduce the final dividend," Stump said.
MIM earlier said it would cut its final dividend to 1.25 cents a share for the second half of 1995/96 from 2.5 cents a year earlier.
MIM reported a net profit before abnormals and exchange gains or losses of A$29.8 million in the 1995/96 year, compared with a loss of A$38.0 million a year earlier.
The result was within market expectations of between A$19.5 million and A$35 million.
MIM also reported a operating profit of A$76.7 million for 1995/96, compared with a loss of A$9.2 million a year earlier.
At 2.03 p.m. (0403 GMT), MIM shares were five cents up at A$1.64.
